purpose: Builds a dead-time mask for a video by segmenting it at broadcast-cut boundaries (detected via PySceneDetect) and labelling each segment live or dead based on a court-view vote fraction. The mask is fed into the main segmentation pipeline where True indicates a frame is dead (not live court view).

public_api.name: detect_cuts
public_api.role: Find broadcast-cut frame indices in a downsampled video using PySceneDetect's content detector; returns the first frame of each new scene. Caller would use this to segment a video into cut-to-cut intervals.

public_api.name: build_composition_mask
public_api.role: Segment a timeline at cut boundaries, compute the mean court-view vote per segment, mark segments dead if vote falls below a threshold, and return a boolean dead-mask plus metadata for each segment. Caller would use this to convert cut frames and a per-frame vote array into a mask for the segmenter.

public_api.name: CompositionSegment
public_api.role: NamedTuple holding one cut-to-cut segment's bounds, the court-view fraction, and dead/live status. Used internally to track segment-level decisions and to report results.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point to run the full composition-mask pipeline on a video: detect cuts, build the mask from a precomputed court-view vote file, and save the result. Caller would invoke this as a subprocess stage with a video path, vote file, and parameters.
